title: Yellowed Woodfired Slovakian Pork Bake
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring fatty pork and unflavored gelatin, baked in a wood-fired oven and served in a copper mug. This recipe is FODMAP-friendly and perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the pork belly, unflavored gelatin, water, caraway seeds, salt, black pepper, and garlic-free seasoning.
Pour the mixture into a copper mug and place it in the wood-fired oven.
Bake for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender and the gelatin is set.
Remove the mug from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the pork bake hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
To achieve the yellowed effect, brush the pork with a little bit of oil and place it under the broiler for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
